names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 10 octombrie.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 10 Οκτωβρίου, «Όσιος Αμβρόσιος της Όπτινα», with the rank word left off.

The bare name out of days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 143, headed «Амвросий Оптинский, прп.», with the rank word and the epithet left off. The life gives his name in the world, Александр Михайлович Гренков, and says the monastic name was given in memory of Ambrose of Milan.

birth.note: The Russian life leaves the day of the month open where the Greek page does not: «родился 21 или 23 ноября 1812 года, в духовной семье села Большие Липовицы Тамбовской Епархии» against saint.gr's «στις 23 Νοεμβρίου του 1812». The year is not in doubt, the day is, and the display no longer prints a day neither source agrees on.

death.note: The Russian life names the hour as well as the year: «Был вечер 10 (22) октября» of 1891, which is the day the calendar keeps him on. The day line prints «(1891)».

feast.note: This is the day of his repose, the evening of 10 October 1891 old style. His name page lists two others, «27 июня» and «11 октября (Оптин.)», the synaxis of the Optina elders. One row per church is the schema, so both are recorded here and he does not render on either.

source.text: days.pravoslavie.ru, 10 октября ст. ст. — «Прп. Амвросия Оптинского (1891).»
source.note: The rank is the alt text of the second of the day's two icons, «Совершается служба с полиелеем» — a service with the polyeleos — and it stands immediately before his line and before nobody else's. The first icon, the plain service, stands at the head of the paragraph before Eulampius and Eulampia and is theirs; the line after his, Innocent of Penza, carries no icon, and reading the polyeleos onto it would be an inference.

attestations.note: The Russian is where the substance of this folder now comes from: saint.gr had the birth, the village and 1891, and the Russian has the whole of the rest, including his name in the world, Александр Гренков. It also prints his own account of his character — «Я — человек уступчивый» — and his birth with the day unsettled, «родился 21 или 23 ноября 1812 года», where saint.gr prints the 23rd flat. Three days are his: 27 June, this one, and 11 October with the Optina elders.

source.text: doxologia.ro, calendarul pe 10 octombrie — «Sfântul Ambrozie de la Optina»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 10ης Οκτωβρίου — «Όσιος Αμβρόσιος της Όπτινα»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 10 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder already keeps, and the entry is the same man: Alexander Grenkov, sixth of the eight children of Michael Theodorovich Grenkov and Martha Nikolaevna, born at Great Lipovitsa in the Tambov region on 23 November 1812, a seminarian and then a teacher, a monk at Optina, deacon on 2 February 1843 and priest at the end of 1845, dead on 10 October 1891 and canonised in 1990. The page states those dates, so a `dates` object is proposed from its own words. It prints no hymn for him. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.
